Accuracy class (III) and (IIII)
Maximum number of verification scale intervals 6000
Load cell excitation voltage 5 V DC
Minimum input voltage per verification scale interval 1,0 μV
Minimum load cell resistance 300 Ω

6-wire (remote sensing)

Multiple range

internal battery
Application Intended to be used for direct sales to the public
Software identification W100 for the 500 Series;
W200 for the 500-SW Series and D-900.
101
